column7: CreateShareRecord's unique-violation fallback (after losing the #136 create race) copied the caller's Permission but not ExpiresAt, so a time-bound share that lost the race came back permanent (fails open toward a longer-lived grant). The fallback now goes through the same apply-fields helper as the re-share path, so the two cannot drift again. The test lands a competing permanent share between the lookup and the INSERT and asserts expires_at in the database, on SQLite and on Postgres (second connection). Red on unmodified main 5d80e2cf (LEASE-SHARE-RACE-1).
